liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jam** (1 other source): Opens with impromptu Alligator vocals from Pigpen, then later morphs into something else [1]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Earliest known appearance of the piece; its first live performance came two days later, on 10/22/67 [2]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): The Viola Lee here is filler edited in from the 1-14-67 show, not studio material [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Lovelight Instrumental Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Cryptical Envelopment [7]

## The recordings

- **gd67-10-20.studio.poynton-sirmick.85631.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 6 songs; 45 min; rated 2.6/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Some hiss is present, worse on certain tracks, but nothing too bad; This copy has harsh, trebley sound; the reviewer recommends another copy of the same session; Songs sound tuned down a half step and sleepy; reviewer wonders if the tape was duplicated at the wrong speed [1][4][6]

## Around the show

- Sounds like an Anthem of the Sun studio session; Mickey Hart, not yet playing shows with the band, is audible on percussion [2]
- Reviewer hears Pig on congas and suspects a rehearsal, since Viola Lee was played [3]
- The band sounds less inspired and energetic than on the live shows from 1967 [2]
- Most of the session matches another 1967 session copy, which also has a unique studio Smokestack Lightning [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd67-10-20.studio.poynton-sirmick.85631.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SirMick; source: Hunter's MSR [1]. Also: Source is a CDR from Jeremy Poynton [1]
